hook: One vial, held on screen long enough to look at. No offer, no claim.
hypothesis: In a feed of shouted discounts, restraint is the pattern interrupt — a product held still reads as a company with something to show rather than something to move. Disproved if view-through is at or below the offer-led control, which would mean the format needs a spoken line to survive without a hook sentence.
opening_frame: Extreme macro on the crimp seal, already drifting. The frame is 90% black. One thin champagne highlight runs down the aluminium edge. No logo, no text, no product name yet.

shot_list.shot: EXTREME MACRO, slow drift left to right across the crimp seal and glass shoulder. Deep focus. Nothing else in frame.
MACRO, slow push in on the white lyophilized cake through the glass — its texture, the shadow it casts inside the vial. Product name sets in the black field beside it.
MEDIUM, locked off. Full vial upright on matte charcoal, lit from behind and above, soft true contact shadow, background falling to pure black.
MEDIUM WIDE, slow reverse dolly settling into the same composition as shot 3 so the clip loops cleanly. Wordmark and CTA appear in negative space.

visual_direction: The direct correction of the black-and-gold offer cut. Cool white key from behind, one restrained champagne-gold edge accent on glass and metal only — never filling a shape and never more than ~8% of frame. No ring-light halo, no gold silk, no bloom, no lens flare. Background #0a0a0a pure neutral. Four shots in twelve seconds: each holds long enough to be looked at. Transitions are eased dissolves or slow cuts on the beat, 200-350ms, nothing whips, nothing bounces.

on_screen_text.note: Fraunces 500, tight tracking, set in the black field to the right of the vial. Never over the printed label.
Manrope, muted #a3a3a3, directly under the product name, same left edge.
Wordmark only, small, upper-middle third. Not a full-bleed logo card.
Manrope with a hairline gold rule beneath — a rule, not a filled pill. Above the bottom 20% band.

on_screen_text.text: For laboratory research use only. Not for human consumption.
on_screen_text.note: Persistent, muted, single instance, above the bottom 20% safe area.

caption: ghk-cu, 70mg, lyophilized. that is the whole post.
audience: Cold, top of funnel. Viewers who scroll past discount creative reflexively and respond to production restraint as a proxy for seriousness.

claims_used.source: Product identity as printed on the label artwork and listed in the catalogue. VERIFY the SKU, mass and stock status against the live product page before shoot.

claims_used.claim: Vanta Labs sells laboratory research materials

no_claims_made: No purity figure, batch number, testing date or laboratory name appears on screen at any point.
No price, discount, bundle or promotion.
No outcome, benefit or use of any kind — the ad describes what the object is and stops.
notes: This is the replacement for the 8s BUY 2 GET 1 offer cut. Same asset class, same product, opposite posture. Shoot or render one SKU only — the offer cut intercut GLOW and GHK-Cu labels on the same lot and read as a mislabelling error. Music must be commercially licensed for paid use; trending audio is not cleared.
